note: Learning pilot protocol, decision mode (Ümit #6225): arms control and records only; the records go at the start of `state` + a blank line (decision.rs state_with_block); context_gate server_invalid: a request the server refuses as too long is an invalid answer, the player goes on. Player: v3.db players.settings of 'GLiClass v4 Edge' (the league's frozen settings), plus context_gate. Limit 16,384 (gliclass_server.py: state, instructions and up to max_choices 218 labels share one 16,384-token input, refused (422) above, never cut); prompt_max = the median League 1 request alone, 3,214 tokens of its tokenizer (plain), so the note budget is limit - prompt_max - 1,500 = 11,670; the oldest whole games are dropped past it (logged). Partial fit: with one game record at the start of state, 4 of 744 stored League 1 requests are over the limit with the median record and 12 with the largest (context_fit.py); with several games in the note more are refused; each refusal counts as an invalid answer.

players.name: GLiClass v4 Edge
players.note: knowledgator's GLiClass v4 Edge (Hugging Face knowledgator/gliclass-v4-edge @ 885af1af8a07edf4ed34df83ca0d995ed8201283, Apache-2.0; a 0.44B GLiClass uni-encoder on DeBERTa-v3-large with a calibrator, text only) on our GPU behind turkce's runner/servers/gliclass_server.py (sha256 aa39e5f435c74f64b6ec905c2965d0ae5b76fa68b7bbf48f7c8a46bde52229e1), the card's own System One mapping (its jev_api.py: one gliclass 0.1.22 pass per choice question, the state as text, the instructions as prompt, each option's description as a label; probabilities the softmax over the calibrated label logits), BF16, model field knowledgator/gliclass-v4-edge. max_choices 218: options, instructions and state share one 16,384-token input (refused with 422 above it, never cut); League 1's worst case, the longest state (2,197 tokens) plus 218 options at the longest label (65 tokens), is 16,367, so play lists over 218 options are split into equal groups of at most 218 and a final among the group winners (the league's split rule, as Winnow and Clef): 24 of League 1's 36,995 decisions had more than 218 options (8 of them over 255). Nothing shortened or refused.
